criteria.statement: Current WorkerDiscovery and WorkerCatalogService runtime reachability is documented with repository-search evidence.
Dormant Loom WorkerDiscovery and WorkerCatalogService code paths are absent from internal production code when no active caller exists.

No unsupported Cashu live-token payment-preparation path is wired by this work.
